A baby has stolen the spotlight in Australia's Parliament. Senator Fatima Payman was addressing the Senate on the Digital Duty of Care Bill when her daughter, Aaliyah, began playing peek-a-boo with fellow politician Senator Lidia Thorpe. Footage shows Thorpe hiding behind her chair as the baby follows the playful exchange. The adorable moment unfolded during parliamentary proceedings in Canberra on November 24.
